questions.prompt: What creates a durable sense of meaning or purpose?

vocabularyClusters.definition: Meaning/purpose is produced by a deliberate inner practice, not received passively.

termsByBook.termAsUsed: the three roads to meaning (work, love, suffering)

positions.stance: Meaning is forged retroactively, through how one responds to unchosen suffering (tragic optimism).
Meaning/purpose is built proactively, through preparation and eliminating doubt before adversity arrives.

crossEdges.label: both frame meaning as a discipline, not a discovery
